entities.summary: Christopher Daniel Soriano Jr., better known by his stage name CJ, is an American rapper and singer. He is best known for his 2020 breakout single "Whoopty", which peaked at number 3 on the UK Singles Chart and at number 10 on the US Billboard Hot 100. The song was later included on his debut EP, Loyalty Over Royalty, released in February 2021.
